summary: Five experiments occupied 63.6 minutes, including two compute-bound entries. The 53.27-minute gated all-three-model atomic-support union A/B was the primary operational tail, followed by the 9.69-minute aggregation-aware repair; the supplied records rank these entries but do not separate readiness waiting, setup, and active computation.
bottlenecks_identified: The 53.27-minute gated all-three-model atomic-support union A/B concentrated most of the recorded wall time, but no phase spans identify whether the delay occurred before or during computation.
The 9.69-minute aggregation-aware adversarial-verifier substrate repair was the second-longest compute-bound entry, with no finer timing attribution available.
The GPU monitor snapshot is not joined to experiment start and end times; consistent with the locked false classification, compute-task utilization efficiency is not established.
No supplied trace records simultaneous model count or runner selection, so a failure to engage DualGPURunner cannot be established.
improvements_suggested: Emit readiness-wait, setup, active-compute, and teardown timestamps in every compute-bound experiment artifact.
Sample GPU utilization by experiment, process, and device throughout each active-compute span so utilization snapshots can be interpreted in task context.
Add a model-count-aware runner preflight that records the dispatch decision and selects DualGPURunner only when two or more models will be loaded simultaneously.
Trigger gated work directly from prerequisite-artifact readiness and record the trigger timestamp to expose avoidable scheduling delay.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the long gated experiment with readiness-to-start and per-phase timers.
Add task-scoped GPU process telemetry covering the full active-compute interval.
Record planned simultaneous model count and automatically dispatch eligible multi-model work through DualGPURunner.
meta_reflection: The data identifies the compute tail precisely but cannot explain its cause or grade GPU efficiency over task lifetimes. A joined experiment-phase, GPU-process, model-concurrency, and runner trace is required before assigning a nonzero savings estimate.
